push.title: W 5-1 vs Old Spice 37 | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #7)
push.body:
buddskees, they don't make the rating any higher than that. Perfect Game #7 against Old Spice 37. Somebody ring a bell.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 7th Perfect Game for us. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ 3 shots at Old Spice 37's goal. You kept the pressure on like a lid on a pot.
+ 1 key pass. You threaded the needle and stitched up a chance.
+ Man of the Match, your 24th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 8.2. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 1. Tiny tweak: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 22 (best was PhogsToffees's 27). That's on the to-do list now.
- Shots 3, from 6 in your previous match. Here's the play: Live on the last defender's shoulder and time the run as the passer lifts their head.

Drill of the day: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Last thing, buddskees. Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

Gold star, big hug, see you next match. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 5-1 vs Old Spice 37 | You: 9.2
push.body:
PhogsToffees, that 9.2 was a big ol' slice of good football.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ A goal against Old Spice 37, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's how you turn a chance into a memory.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and buddskees.
+ Won your matchup: 9.2 against their best forward's 7.4. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ Passes attempted 27, up from your usual 20. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.

THE BAD
- Shots 1, down from your usual 3. Keep this in your pocket: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Think about this: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Most misplaced passes on the team: 6 (best was buddskees's 3). That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.

Drill: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: The scoreboard counts goals; I count growth.

I'm framing this one. - Coach Lasso

+ 4 shots at Old Spice 37's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 1 key pass. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ buddskees scored and you were the reason. Take a bow.
+ Match rating 8.5, up from your usual 7.4. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ 3rd straight match at 50% tackle success. Little things like that are big things in disguise.

THE BAD
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Fix it like this: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. That's how good becomes great.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.5 (best was buddskees's 10.0). Not who you are, but it was who showed up.
- Lowest assists on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 2). That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Lowest completed passes on the team: 18 (best was PhogsToffees's 21). We don't hide from that one; we fix it.
- 2 tackles won: -0.1. Let's polish that.

Homework: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

BellyTb1, take this with you: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

That one goes in the memory bank. - Coach Lasso
